intro.fallback: Having caught word of Pain's attack, the toads at Mount Myōboku prepared for the counter-attack.

Shima, who was at Konoha at the time, was told to prepare a reverse summoning to bring Naruto, Fukasaku, Gamabunta, Gamaken, Gamahiro, and Gamakichi to Konoha, moments after the Shinra Tensei levelled the village.
After using the Naraka Path to repair the destroyed Asura Path, the Animal Path was launched back into the village and re-summoned the rest of the paths back into the village to fight the jinchūriki.
